title: Case 94: Millie & Trevor Horn, Janice Saunders

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode deals with a crime committed against a child that won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的案件涉及一起针对儿童的犯罪，内容可能引起部分听众不适。

sentences.en: On the evening of March 2, 1993, 43-year-old Mildred Horne, known by friends as Millie, found herself in a predicament.
sentences.zh: 1993年3月2日傍晚，43岁的米尔德里德·霍恩（朋友们称她为米莉）陷入了困境。

sentences.en: A senior flight attendant with American Airlines, Millie was rostered on flight 731 to San Juan,
sentences.zh: 作为美国航空的一名资深空乘，米莉被排班执飞前往圣胡安的731号航班，

sentences.en: departing the following morning at 8.07 from Baltimore, Washington International Airport.
sentences.zh: 该航班将于次日上午8点07分从巴尔的摩-华盛顿国际机场起飞。

sentences.en: Due to her early start, the single mother needed others to look after her children.
sentences.zh: 由于需要早起，这位单身母亲必须找人照顾她的孩子们。

sentences.en: It wasn't an issue for her eldest daughter, 18-year-old Tiffany, a freshman living on campus at Howard University in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 这对她18岁的大女儿蒂芙尼来说不是问题，蒂芙尼是华盛顿特区霍华德大学的一名住校大一新生。

sentences.en: It was Millie's 8-year-old twins, Tamiel and Trevor, who required a sitter.
sentences.zh: 但米莉8岁的双胞胎孩子——塔米尔和特雷弗，则需要人看护。

sentences.en: Millie was able to send Tamiel to spend the night at her mother's.
sentences.zh: 米莉成功安排塔米尔去外婆家过夜。

sentences.en: However, Tamiel's twin brother Trevor was unable to stay elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 然而，塔米尔的双胞胎弟弟特雷弗却无法去别处留宿。

sentences.en: Severely physically and intellectually disabled, Trevor required around-the-clock care.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗患有严重的生理和智力残疾，需要全天候的护理。

sentences.en: He could barely see, hear or speak, and was often bedridden.
sentences.zh: 他几乎看不见、听不见也说不出话，且经常卧床不起。

sentences.en: Suffering from underdeveloped lungs, he breathed through a tracheostomy tube, receiving oxygen and humidification via tubing that ran from a portable oxygen tank.
sentences.zh: 由于肺部发育不全，他需要通过气管切开导管呼吸，并依靠便携式氧气瓶通过管道输送氧气和加湿空气。

sentences.en: When he went to school, Trevor was accompanied by a nurse who monitored his oxygen at all times.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗上学时，会有一名护士全程陪同，时刻监测他的氧气供应。

sentences.en: Described as a cheerful and happy youngster, Trevor was making exceptional progress in class.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗被描述为一个开朗快乐的孩子，在课堂上进步神速。

sentences.en: He had mastered a few words in sign language and enjoyed his physical education class and playing games with friends.
sentences.zh: 他已经掌握了几个手语单词，非常喜欢体育课，也爱和朋友们玩游戏。

sentences.en: When it came to Trevor, Millie was described as a super mum.
sentences.zh: 提到特雷弗，人们都说米莉是一位“超级妈妈”。

sentences.en: A formidable and extraordinary mother, she devoted herself to ensuring her son received the very best of care and showered him with unconditional love.
sentences.zh: 她是一位了不起的母亲，全身心地投入到确保儿子得到最好的照顾中，并给予他无条件的爱。

sentences.en: The pair were often seen out and about, Millie gently pushing Trevor along in his wheelchair or driving him around in her specially modified Chevrolet Astro minivan.
sentences.zh: 母子俩经常一起出门，米莉会温柔地推着轮椅上的特雷弗，或者开着她那辆经过特殊改装的雪佛兰雅斯特面包车带他四处转转。

sentences.en: During Halloween, Millie would help dress Trevor up as his favourite fictional character, the free-spirited and mischievous Peter Pan.
sentences.zh: 万圣节时，米莉会帮特雷弗打扮成他最喜欢的虚构人物——那个自由奔放、调皮捣蛋的彼得·潘。

sentences.en: Trevor loved visiting relatives who dubbed him Tricky Trev.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗喜欢探望亲戚，他们给他起了个绰号叫“调皮特雷夫”。

sentences.en: His cheeky laughter carried throughout the house, bringing joy to all those who heard it.
sentences.zh: 他那顽皮的笑声传遍了整个屋子，给所有听到的人带来了欢乐。

sentences.en: He inherited a love for music and clearly had his favourite tunes, reacting with delight when they were played.
sentences.zh: 他继承了对音乐的热爱，显然有自己最喜欢的曲子，每当音乐响起，他都会兴奋地回应。

sentences.en: The devotion and dedication of his mother, siblings and extended family towards Trev was to those who witnessed it.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲、兄弟姐妹以及大家庭对特雷弗的奉献与关爱，所有目睹这一切的人都深有感触。

sentences.en: Totally beautiful.
sentences.zh: 简直太美好了。

sentences.en: Despite doctors believing such an achievement would be impossible,
sentences.zh: 尽管医生认为这样的成就几乎是不可能的，

sentences.en: Trevor was able to vocalise some words and had developed his own special language.
sentences.zh: 但特雷弗还是能够发出一些声音，并发展出了自己独特的语言。

sentences.en: Elle referred to his twin sister, Tammyelle.
sentences.zh: “Elle”指的是他的双胞胎姐姐塔米尔。

sentences.en: La la meant I love you.
sentences.zh: “La la”的意思是“我爱你”。

sentences.en: During the night, Trevor relied on a life-support machine to assist his breathing as he slept.
sentences.zh: 夜里，特雷弗睡觉时需要依靠生命维持设备来辅助呼吸。

sentences.en: A constant vigilance and monitoring of these machines was crucial as they were responsible for keeping Trevor alive.
sentences.zh: 对这些设备进行持续的警惕和监测至关重要，因为它们负责维持特雷弗的生命。

sentences.en: The nurse rostered on to supervise Trevor the evening of March 2, 1993, called up unwell and was unable to stay over.
sentences.zh: 原定于1993年3月2日晚负责看护特雷弗的护士打来电话说身体不适，无法留宿。

sentences.en: Millie couldn't stay up watching over her son as she needed to rest in preparation for her flight the following morning.
sentences.zh: 米莉无法熬夜看护儿子，因为她需要休息，为次日的飞行任务做准备。

sentences.en: Millie's sister, Vivian, was always more than happy to look after her nephew.
sentences.zh: 米莉的姐姐薇薇安一直很乐意照顾外甥。

sentences.en: However, on this occasion, Vivian reluctantly declined, as she too had work the following day.
sentences.zh: 然而这一次，薇薇安勉强拒绝了，因为她第二天也要上班。

sentences.en: Millie contacted another one of Trevor's nurses, 38-year-old Janice Saunders.
sentences.zh: 米莉联系了特雷弗的另一位护士，38岁的珍妮丝·桑德斯。

sentences.en: That night, Janice was home with her husband, Michael, and their five-year-old son.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，珍妮丝正和丈夫迈克尔以及五岁的儿子在家。

sentences.en: When she received the call from Millie, Janice understood the mother's dilemma.
sentences.zh: 接到米莉的电话后，珍妮丝理解这位母亲的困境。

sentences.en: Having worked for the Horns for five years, Janice developed a strong fondness of young Trevor.
sentences.zh: 为霍恩家工作了五年，珍妮丝对小特雷弗产生了深厚的感情。

sentences.en: She graciously agreed to step in at the last minute and watch Trevor over the night of March 2 to 3, to ensure both child and mother slept well.
sentences.zh: 她欣然同意临时顶替，在3月2日到3日晚间照顾特雷弗，以确保孩子和母亲都能睡个好觉。

sentences.en: To help pass time throughout the late hours, Janice took with her some needlework.
sentences.zh: 为了打发深夜的时光，珍妮丝带了一些针线活。

sentences.en: She recently started a cross-stitch pattern titled The Parade.
sentences.zh: 她最近开始绣一幅名为《游行》的十字绣图案。

sentences.en: The image was by artist P.
sentences.zh: 这幅画出自艺术家P·巴克利·莫斯之手，

sentences.en: Buckley Moss, whose work Janice discovered years earlier and instantly loved.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝多年前就发现了这位艺术家的作品，并立刻爱上了它。

sentences.en: So much so, that this was the fifth cross-stitch of her art Janice created.
sentences.zh: 以至于这已经是珍妮丝创作的第五幅基于其艺术作品的十字绣了。

sentences.en: It showed a boy pulling a wagon carrying a girl and her collection of black kittens.
sentences.zh: 画中是一个男孩拉着一辆马车，车上坐着一个女孩和她的一群小黑猫。

sentences.en: Janice had only gotten so far as stitching the boy's hat, and hoped to make significant progress on her project whilst watching over sleeping Trevor.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝当时只绣好了男孩的帽子，她希望在看护熟睡的特雷弗时，能在这个项目上取得重大进展。

sentences.en: It was around 7.15 the following morning of March 3, when Vivian drove to her sister's white, two-story brick house on the leafy suburban Northgate Drive.
sentences.zh: 次日即3月3日早上7点15分左右，薇薇安开车前往她妹妹位于绿树成荫的北门大道上那栋白色两层砖房。

sentences.en: It was only a short trip as Vivian lived only a few doors down from Millie.
sentences.zh: 路程很短，因为薇薇安就住在离米莉家几户之隔的地方。

sentences.en: The pair resided in the well-to-do area of Silver Spring, in the coastal state of Maryland, on America's east coaSt.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩居住在马里兰州沿海地区银泉市的一个富裕社区，位于美国东海岸。

sentences.en: As Millie would have already left for work,
sentences.zh: 由于米莉此时应该已经出门上班了，

sentences.en: Vivian knew the only one's home would be her nephew Trevor and his nurse.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安知道家里应该只有外甥特雷弗和他的护士。

sentences.en: Janice Saunders.
sentences.zh: 也就是珍妮丝·桑德斯。

sentences.en: Janice was due to finish her 10-hour night shift at 8am.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝本应在早上8点结束她10小时的夜班。

sentences.en: Grateful the nurse took the shift on such short notice,
sentences.zh: 薇薇安很感激护士在如此短的时间内接下这个班，

sentences.en: Vivian was keen to ensure Janice left on time and didn't have to stay longer than expected.
sentences.zh: 她希望能确保珍妮丝准时下班，不必比预期多待。

sentences.en: Vivian pulled up out the front of her sister's house.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安把车停在妹妹家门前。

sentences.en: She immediately noticed the garage door was wide open, with nobody in sight.
sentences.zh: 她立刻注意到车库门大开着，里面空无一人。

sentences.en: Millie's minivan was missing.
sentences.zh: 米莉的面包车不见了。

sentences.en: Vivian had never known her sister to leave the garage open when she wasn't home.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安从没见过妹妹在不在家时把车库门敞开。

sentences.en: Upon entering the garage, something was clearly amiss.
sentences.zh: 走进车库后，她明显感觉到有些不对劲。

sentences.en: Sofa cushions were strewn across the floor.
sentences.zh: 沙发垫散落在地板上。

sentences.en: Vivian's attention was drawn to a sound coming from inside the house that was both familiar and out of place.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安被屋内传来的一种声音吸引了，那声音既熟悉又显得格格不入。

sentences.en: It was the furious, high-pitched beeping of young Trevor's apnea monitor.
sentences.zh: 那是小特雷弗的呼吸暂停监测仪发出的急促、尖锐的蜂鸣声。

sentences.en: The sound it made to alert the nurse.
sentences.zh: 那是用来提醒护士的声音。

sentences.en: Trevor had stopped breathing.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗停止了呼吸。

sentences.en: Overcome with worry, Vivian rushed to a neighbour's property and beat the front door.
sentences.zh: 忧心忡忡的薇薇安冲到邻居家，用力敲门。

sentences.en: She begged them to accompany her into her sister's house.
sentences.zh: 她恳求他们陪她一起进妹妹家。

sentences.en: After unlocking the front door, Vivian let the neighbour enter the house firSt.
sentences.zh: 打开前门后，薇薇安让邻居先进屋。

sentences.en: But the door would barely open.
sentences.zh: 但门几乎推不开。

sentences.en: There was something heavy on the other side blocking their entry.
sentences.zh: 门后有什么沉重的东西挡住了去路。

sentences.en: Vivian peered through the gap to see what was in the way.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安透过缝隙往里看，想弄清楚是什么挡住了门。

sentences.en: Looking into the house, she saw a body on the floor against the door.
sentences.zh: 她往屋里看去，发现地板上有一具尸体正对着门。

sentences.en: Her sister Millie's fixed and unblinking gaze was staring up at her.
sentences.zh: 她妹妹米莉那双凝固且不眨眼的眼睛正盯着她看。

sentences.en: Half of her face was missing.
sentences.zh: 她半张脸都不见了。

sentences.en: Police arrived to the Horne family house within minutes.
sentences.zh: 警方在几分钟内赶到了霍恩家。

sentences.en: Upon entry, they immediately found Millie Horne's body by the front door.
sentences.zh: 进入屋内后，他们立即在前门发现了米莉·霍恩的遗体。

sentences.en: Wearing her nightclothes, it appeared she had been shot in the face at close range by a high-powered weapon.
sentences.zh: 她穿着睡衣，看起来是在近距离被大威力武器击中面部。

sentences.en: Following the sound of the beer bin, the officers headed upstairs.
sentences.zh: 循着蜂鸣声，警官们上了楼。

sentences.en: It led them to eight-year-old Trevor Horne's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 声音将他们引向了八岁特雷弗·霍恩的卧室。

sentences.en: The inside of the room was clean and orderly, much like a hospital room.
sentences.zh: 房间内部干净整洁，就像病房一样。

sentences.en: Except for the blood surrounding the body of Nurse Janice Saunders on the floor.
sentences.zh: 除了地板上护士珍妮丝·桑德斯遗体周围的血迹外。

sentences.en: She, too, had been shot dead.
sentences.zh: 她也遭枪杀身亡。

sentences.en: Two small abrasions above Janice's right eyebrow looked to have been caused by tiny debris from a silencer.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝右眉上方有两处小擦伤，看起来像是消音器喷出的微小碎片造成的。

sentences.en: The officers approached the specially built crib-like bed by the beeping machine.
sentences.zh: 警官们走向蜂鸣器旁那张特制的婴儿床式病床。

sentences.en: Each beep signalled for each breath that was missed.
sentences.zh: 每一声蜂鸣都代表着一次错过的呼吸。

sentences.en: Laying inside, surrounded by his beloved stuffed animals, was Trevor.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗躺在里面，周围环绕着他心爱的毛绒玩具。

sentences.en: His body showed no external signs of trauma.
sentences.zh: 他的身体表面没有外伤痕迹。

sentences.en: The boy's left eye was speckled with pinpoint bleeding, suggesting he had made violent attempts to breathe prior to death.
sentences.zh: 男孩的左眼布满了针尖状的出血点，这表明他在死前曾有过剧烈的呼吸挣扎。

sentences.en: It appeared as though Trevor's killer plugged the child's tracheostomy tube with their finger,
sentences.zh: 看起来凶手是用手指堵住了特雷弗的气管切开导管，

sentences.en: and perhaps held their other hand over the boy's mouth and nose, suffocating him to death.
sentences.zh: 或许还用另一只手捂住了男孩的口鼻，将他活活闷死。

sentences.en: A few areas of the Horne house were obviously disturbed.
sentences.zh: 霍恩家有几个地方明显被翻动过。

sentences.en: Some drawers were tossed about.
sentences.zh: 一些抽屉被翻得乱七八糟。

sentences.en: A cocktail table in the living room had been moved.
sentences.zh: 客厅里的一张鸡尾酒桌被挪动了位置。

sentences.en: Cushions were on the floor and a rug kicked to the side.
sentences.zh: 靠垫掉在地板上，地毯也被踢到了一边。

sentences.en: Scattered on a bathroom floor were the contents of Millie's purse.
sentences.zh: 浴室地板上散落着米莉钱包里的东西。

sentences.en: A bookcase was toppled over, and a hallway closet was open, its contents dumped haphazardly on the floor.
sentences.zh: 一个书架被推倒，走廊里的壁橱敞开着，里面的东西杂乱无章地堆在地板上。

sentences.en: In the basement, the mesh screen of a window was pulled away, and there were pry marks on the frame.
sentences.zh: 在地下室，一扇窗户的纱窗被拉开，窗框上有撬动的痕迹。

sentences.en: Police surmised the intruder broke in this way.
sentences.zh: 警方推测入侵者就是从这里闯入的。

sentences.en: From the messy state of the house and the markings on the basement window, all signs pointed to a burglary gone horribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 从屋内凌乱的状态和地下室窗户上的痕迹来看，所有迹象都指向这是一起出了岔子的入室盗窃案。

sentences.en: If it was a burglary, it was a particularly incompetent one.
sentences.zh: 如果这真的是一起盗窃案，那也太业余了。

sentences.en: Despite nearly every room having been slightly ransacked, little of value appeared to be missing.
sentences.zh: 尽管几乎每个房间都被翻得乱七八糟，但似乎没丢什么值钱的东西。

sentences.en: None of Millie Horne's substantial collection of jewellery, including a five-carat diamond bracelet lying in plain sight on a bathroom counter, was taken.
sentences.zh: 米莉·霍恩收藏的大量珠宝一件都没少，包括放在浴室台面上显眼位置的一条五克拉钻石手链。

sentences.en: Janice Saunders' purse and jewellery were undisturbed.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝·桑德斯的钱包和珠宝也未被动过。

sentences.en: Furs, televisions, music and electronic equipment, usually prime targets for burglars because of the ease with which they could be quickly sold, all remained untouched.
sentences.zh: 皮草、电视机、音响和电子设备——这些通常因容易快速变现而成为窃贼首选目标的东西，全都完好无损。

sentences.en: All that was missing were some credit and check cashing cards taken from Millie's purse.
sentences.zh: 唯一丢失的只有从米莉钱包里拿走的几张信用卡和支票兑现卡。

sentences.en: Seasoned detectives suspected the scene was staged to look like a burglary gone wrong, to mask what actually appeared to be a planned and professional murder.
sentences.zh: 经验丰富的侦探怀疑现场是伪装成入室盗窃失败的假象，以此掩盖这起看起来是有预谋的职业谋杀案。

sentences.en: The victims were killed with ruthless efficiency,
sentences.zh: 受害者被冷酷高效地杀害了，

sentences.en: Millie with three gunshots to the head, and Janice with two.
sentences.zh: 米莉头部中三枪，珍妮丝中两枪。

sentences.en: Young Trevor's death was senseless.
sentences.zh: 小特雷弗的死毫无意义。

sentences.en: The child had no way of identifying the intruder or telling anyone what happened, yet the killer took no chances.
sentences.zh: 这个孩子根本无法辨认入侵者或告诉任何人发生了什么，但凶手还是不留后患。

sentences.en: Forensics went over the hornhouse with a fine-toothed comb, but no foreign fibres or hairs or any shoe, palm or fingerprints had been left at the scene.
sentences.zh: 法医对霍恩家进行了地毯式搜查，但现场没有留下任何外来纤维、毛发，也没有任何鞋印、掌纹或指纹。

sentences.en: Fragments of one .22 caliber bullet was found lodged in a wall in Trevor's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 在特雷弗卧室的墙壁里发现了一枚.22口径子弹的碎片。

sentences.en: .22 caliber bullets are liable to the stored upon firing, making it hard to match the bullet to a gun.
sentences.zh: .22口径子弹在发射时容易变形，这使得很难将子弹与枪支进行比对。

sentences.en: Only two things were left behind by the killer at the scene.
sentences.zh: 凶手在现场只留下了两样东西。

sentences.en: A small file with tape around the handle was found near the garage door.
sentences.zh: 在车库门附近发现了一个手柄上缠着胶带的小锉刀。

sentences.en: It tested positive for gunshot residue.
sentences.zh: 经检测，上面有枪击残留物。

sentences.en: The second item was flecks of grass on Trevor Horn's face.
sentences.zh: 第二样东西是特雷弗·霍恩脸上沾着的草屑。

sentences.en: Neither item provided investigators any further insight into the perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 这两样东西都没能为调查人员提供关于凶手的进一步线索。

sentences.en: The time of the murder was accurately pinpointed thanks to the meticulous logs kept by Janice Saunders of Trevor's vital signs.
sentences.zh: 多亏了珍妮丝·桑德斯对特雷弗生命体征所做的详尽记录，谋杀时间被精确锁定。

sentences.en: Every hour, without fail,
sentences.zh: 每隔一小时，雷打不动，

sentences.en: Janice wrote her medical observations down in a notebook.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝都会把她的医疗观察记录写在笔记本上。

sentences.en: When they stopped at 2am, police knew the killer arrived a short time later.
sentences.zh: 当记录在凌晨2点停止时，警方知道凶手是在那之后不久到达的。

sentences.en: Millie's minivan was located around midday, found abandoned in the parking lot of a townhouse development in the suburb of Lay Hill, less than a mile from the hornhouse.
sentences.zh: 米莉的面包车在中午左右被找到，被遗弃在离霍恩家不到一英里的莱希尔郊区的一个联排别墅开发区的停车场里。

sentences.en: The vehicle was locked and the keys left in the ignition.
sentences.zh: 车门锁着，钥匙还插在点火开关里。

sentences.en: Investigators believed the killer parked their car at the construction site and walked the one mile to the hornhouse.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为凶手把自己的车停在建筑工地，然后步行一英里来到霍恩家。

sentences.en: After committing the murders, they then drove Millie's van back to their own car, before fleeing.
sentences.zh: 行凶后，他们又开着米莉的面包车回到自己的车旁，然后逃离。

sentences.en: Later that same afternoon,
sentences.zh: 当天下午晚些时候，

sentences.zh: 米莉的信用卡被交到了警方手中。

sentences.en: A jogger running along Route 28 in Montgomery County found the cards scattered on the side of the road, less than 20 miles west of the hornhouse.
sentences.zh: 一名在蒙哥马利县28号公路沿线跑步的慢跑者发现了散落在路边的卡片，距离霍恩家不到20英里。

sentences.en: As the area in and around the crime scene was being carefully searched, investigators went to Howard University to pick up Tiffany Horn.
sentences.zh: 就在犯罪现场及其周边地区被仔细搜查时，调查人员前往霍华德大学接蒂芙尼·霍恩。

sentences.en: Upon hearing her mother and brother had been killed, the 18-year-old blurted out,
sentences.zh: 听到母亲和弟弟被杀的消息，这位18岁的女孩脱口而出：

sentences.en: Lawrence Thomas Horn, better known as LT, was Motown Music Royalty.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯·托马斯·霍恩，人称LT，是摩城唱片的音乐界大亨。

sentences.en: He joined the iconic record production company as a young man in the 1960s, taking a low-paying job as a favour to his friend and Motown Records founder,
sentences.zh: 他在20世纪60年代以年轻人的身份加入了这家标志性的唱片制作公司，作为对他朋友兼摩城唱片创始人的一项人情，他接受了一份低薪工作，

sentences.en: Barry Gordy Jr.
sentences.zh: 巴里·戈迪二世。

sentences.en: A talented sound engineer, before long,
sentences.zh: 作为一名才华横溢的录音工程师，没过多久，

sentences.en: Lawrence was running the control room at Hitsville, USA,
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯就开始负责位于美国底特律的摩城原始总部——“Hitsville, USA”的控制室工作。

sentences.en: Motown's original Detroit headquarters.
sentences.zh: 摩城之声是灵魂乐、放克乐和流行乐的混合体。

sentences.en: The Motown sound was a mixture of soul, funk and pop.
sentences.zh: 在50和60年代，

sentences.en: During the 50s and 60s,
sentences.zh: 摩城签下了许多后来成为巨星的无名艺人。

sentences.en: Motown signed up unknown artists who later became megastars.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·杰克逊和杰克逊五人组，

sentences.en: Michael Jackson and the Jackson Five,
sentences.zh: 以及至高无上合唱团。

sentences.en: The Supremes,
sentences.zh: 至高无上合唱团。

sentences.en: Frankie Valli and the Four Seasons, and Diana Ross, amongst many others.
sentences.zh: 弗兰基·瓦利与四季乐队，还有戴安娜·罗斯，以及其他许多艺人。

sentences.en: Soon, Motown's artists were rocketing to the top of the charts.
sentences.zh: 不久，摩城唱片的艺人们便如火箭般冲上了排行榜榜首。

sentences.en: Lawrence was a pioneer and an innovator, responsible for overseeing most of the mixes for Motown's singles from 1964 to 1967.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯是一位先驱和创新者，负责监督1964年至1967年间摩城唱片大部分单曲的混音工作。

sentences.en: He was the chief technician on the Temptations hit My Girl, which debuted at the top of the charts in 1965 and stayed there for 13 weeks.
sentences.zh: 他是诱惑合唱团热门歌曲《My Girl》的首席技术员，这首歌在1965年首次亮相便登顶排行榜，并蝉联榜首长达13周。

sentences.en: Shotgun by Junior Walker and the All-Stars was Lawrence's proudest achievement.
sentences.zh: 小沃克与全明星乐队的《Shotgun》是劳伦斯最引以为傲的成就。

sentences.en: He was credited as the song's producer, that peaked at number four on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1965.
sentences.zh: 他被列为该歌曲的制作人，这首歌在1965年曾登上公告牌百强单曲榜第四名。

sentences.en: As Motown's fame and fortunes soared, so did Lawrence Horn.
sentences.zh: 随着摩城唱片名利双收，劳伦斯·霍恩也随之水涨船高。

sentences.en: He gained a reputation as a gifted engineer, not afraid to experiment to create new sounds.
sentences.zh: 他赢得了天才工程师的声誉，且不惧通过实验来创造新的音效。

sentences.en: Although never in the limelight, those in the music industry considered Lawrence to be the man behind the Motown sound.
sentences.zh: 尽管从未处于聚光灯下，但音乐界的人士都认为劳伦斯是摩城之声背后的灵魂人物。

sentences.en: He introduced himself as
sentences.zh: 他这样介绍自己：

sentences.en: LT, your man with a plan.
sentences.zh: “LT，你的计划通。”

sentences.en: Popular with the ladies, he had one short-lived marriage to a Motown receptionist, which lasted just a year in the late 60s.
sentences.zh: 他很受女性欢迎，曾与一位摩城唱片的前台有过一段短暂的婚姻，那是在60年代末，仅维持了一年。

sentences.en: Motown moved from Detroit to LA, where it expanded into television and film production.
sentences.zh: 摩城唱片从底特律搬到了洛杉矶，并扩展到了电视和电影制作领域。

sentences.en: As to be expected,
sentences.zh: 不出所料，

sentences.en: Lawrence went with it.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯也随之而去。

sentences.en: Motown Records was a phenomenal success story for a small family-run business.
sentences.zh: 对于一家小型家族企业来说，摩城唱片是一个非凡的成功故事。

sentences.en: As its chief recording engineer,
sentences.zh: 作为其首席录音工程师，

sentences.en: Lawrence Horn was rolling in the money.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯·霍恩当时财源滚滚。

sentences.en: Lawrence crashed his Porsche, completely riding it off.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯撞毁了他的保时捷，车子彻底报废。

sentences.en: He should have been killed, or at least severely injured, but he escaped without a scratch.
sentences.zh: 他本该丧命，或者至少会受重伤，但他却毫发无损地逃过一劫。

sentences.en: Rather than convincing him of his invincibility, the accident caused Lawrence to take stock of his life.
sentences.zh: 这场事故并没有让他觉得自己不可战胜，反而促使劳伦斯重新审视自己的人生。

sentences.en: Shortly after, he was sitting in his first-class seat on an American Airlines flight, when he met an angel he believed was sent by God to save him.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他坐在美国航空公司的头等舱里，遇见了一位他认为是上帝派来拯救他的天使。

sentences.en: Mildred Marie dreamed of being a flight attendant since she was a little girl.
sentences.zh: 米尔德里德·玛丽从小就梦想成为一名空乘人员。

sentences.en: One of 14 children,
sentences.zh: 作为14个孩子中的一员，

sentences.en: Millie grew up in South Carolina in a close and loving family, where chasing one's dreams was encouraged.
sentences.zh: 米莉在南卡罗来纳州一个亲密而充满爱的家庭中长大，在那里，追逐梦想是被鼓励的。

sentences.en: Bubbly, happy, and popular,
sentences.zh: 她活泼、快乐且受欢迎，

sentences.en: Millie was a head-turner, always bell at the ball.
sentences.zh: 米莉是个回头率极高的人，总是舞会上的焦点。

sentences.en: As soon as she was able, she entered stewardess school and excelled in every aspect, easily making it through the gruelling training regime.
sentences.zh: 她一有机会就进入了空姐学校，并在各方面表现优异，轻松通过了严苛的训练。

sentences.en: Even though her work took her all around the country,
sentences.zh: 尽管她的工作让她奔波于全国各地，

sentences.en: Millie always remained deeply woven within her family roots.
sentences.zh: 米莉始终与她的家庭根源紧密相连。

sentences.en: It didn't take long for American Airlines to promote Millie to the position of senior flight attendant.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，美国航空公司就将米莉晋升为高级空乘人员。

sentences.en: Tasked with looking after the more demanding first-class passengers,
sentences.zh: 负责照顾那些要求更高的头等舱乘客，

sentences.en: Millie's patience and optimism saw her settle well into the new role.
sentences.zh: 米莉的耐心和乐观让她很好地适应了这一新角色。

sentences.en: One day, as she worked the Los Angeles flight route, fate had Millie serving drinks to a handsome, confident music executive.
sentences.zh: 一天，当她执飞洛杉矶航线时，命运安排米莉为一位英俊、自信的音乐高管送上饮料。

sentences.en: Lawrence Horn was immediately drawn to the beautiful 21-year-old.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯·霍恩立刻被这位美丽的21岁姑娘吸引住了。

sentences.en: Millie accepted Lawrence's invitation to dinner, and he set about courting her with his elite lifestyle of fine dining, good wine, jet-setting, and celebrities.
sentences.zh: 米莉接受了劳伦斯的晚餐邀请，他开始用他那精英式的生活方式——高级餐饮、美酒、环球旅行和名流交际——来追求她。

sentences.en: Lawrence and Millie became a celebrated couple in Hollywood's music scene.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯和米莉成为了好莱坞音乐圈里一对备受瞩目的情侣。

sentences.en: The pair turned heads at all the glamorous parties.
sentences.zh: 两人在所有奢华派对上都引人注目。

sentences.en: Yet, outside the spotlight and behind closed doors, theirs was a stormy relationship from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 然而，在聚光灯之外，关起门来，他们的关系从一开始就充满了风暴。

sentences.en: Volatility, drama, and fiery fights were followed by passionate reconciliations.
sentences.zh: 反复无常、戏剧性冲突和激烈的争吵之后，往往伴随着充满激情的和解。

sentences.en: Eventually, the pair married in Las Vegas in August 1973.
sentences.zh: 最终，两人于1973年8月在拉斯维加斯结婚。

sentences.en: The birth of their first child,
sentences.zh: 他们的第一个孩子，

sentences.en: Tiffany, in 1974 only served to highlight the issues in their marriage.
sentences.zh: 蒂芙尼于1974年出生，这反而凸显了他们婚姻中的问题。

sentences.en: Lawrence put his job,
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯把他的工作、

sentences.en: Motown, and partying ahead of his parental responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 摩城唱片和派对看得比为人父母的责任更重要。

sentences.en: Millie still loved the extravagant lifestyle
sentences.zh: 米莉依然热爱劳伦斯提供的奢华生活方式，

sentences.en: Lawrence provided, but prioritised family above all else.
sentences.zh: 但她将家庭置于一切之上。

sentences.en: Fights between the couple became more frequent and reconciliations less satisfying.
sentences.zh: 夫妻间的争吵变得更加频繁，和解也变得不再那么令人满意。

sentences.en: Until, in 1979, after five years of marriage, they went their separate ways.
sentences.zh: 直到1979年，结婚五年后，他们分道扬镳。

sentences.en: Millie moved with Tiffany to Maryland to be near her family, whom she could always rely on.
sentences.zh: 米莉带着蒂芙尼搬到了马里兰州，以便靠近她始终可以依赖的家人。

sentences.en: Lawrence stayed in Los Angeles, where he could be close to his beloved Motown.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯留在了洛杉矶，这样他就能离他心爱的摩城唱片更近一些。

sentences.en: During her childhood,
sentences.zh: 在童年时期，

sentences.en: Tiffany's visits with her father were relegated to summer holidays, but they were always exciting.
sentences.zh: 蒂芙尼与父亲的见面仅限于暑假，但总是令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Lawrence took her to Hollywood get-togethers attended by famous singers and musicians.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯带她参加好莱坞的聚会，那里有著名的歌手和音乐家出席。

sentences.en: She especially looked forward to the annual Motown picnic, where the elite of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她特别期待一年一度的摩城野餐会，美国音乐界的精英们会带上家人，

sentences.en: music scene would bring their families to meet the people they worked with.
sentences.zh: 去见他们共事的人。

sentences.en: At one of these events, her father introduced her to Stevie Wonder.
sentences.zh: 在其中一次活动中，父亲把她介绍给了史蒂夫·汪达。

sentences.en: Millie, seemingly moving forward with an independent life, filed for divorce from Lawrence in 1981.
sentences.zh: 米莉似乎正在开启独立生活，并于1981年向劳伦斯提出离婚。

sentences.en: Yet, despite their differences,
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管存在分歧，

sentences.en: Lawrence and Millie found it difficult to stay away from each other.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯和米莉发现很难远离对方。

sentences.en: They would often find themselves together after meeting to drop off or pick up Tiffany, or when Millie's work took her to Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 他们经常在送接蒂芙尼时，或者当米莉因工作来到洛杉矶时，发现自己又在一起了。

sentences.en: A bombshell dropped in 1984.
sentences.zh: 1984年，一个重磅消息传出。

sentences.en: Millie was pregnant, and Lawrence was the father.
sentences.zh: 米莉怀孕了，孩子是劳伦斯的。

sentences.en: It came as a shock to her family, who were under the impression the couple ended things years ago.
sentences.zh: 这对她的家人来说是个震惊，他们还以为这对夫妇几年前就已经结束了。

sentences.en: It was immediately clear to Millie's network of support that Lawrence held no interest in providing her any assistance or comfort during her pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 米莉的支持网络立刻清楚地意识到，劳伦斯对在怀孕期间为她提供任何帮助或安慰毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: Her family rallied around her as they always did, especially when they discovered she was carrying twins.
sentences.zh: 她的家人像往常一样团结在她身边，尤其是当他们发现她怀的是双胞胎时。

sentences.en: Millie went into premature labour at seven months.
sentences.zh: 米莉在七个月时早产。

sentences.zh: 双胞胎塔米·L和特雷弗出生于

sentences.zh: 医生告诉米莉，

sentences.zh: 塔米·L很小但健康状况良好，但特雷弗只有50%的存活率。

sentences.en: During the birth of her twin siblings,
sentences.zh: 在双胞胎姐弟出生期间，

sentences.en: Tiffany was on one of her summer visits with her father in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 蒂芙尼正在洛杉矶与父亲度暑假。

sentences.en: Her aunt Vivian called asking Lawrence to rush Tiffany to Merryland so she would have the opportunity to meet her newborn brother in case Trevor didn't pull through.
sentences.zh: 她的姨妈薇薇安打电话要求劳伦斯赶紧把蒂芙尼送回马里兰州，这样她就有机会见到刚出生的弟弟，以防特雷弗挺不过去。

sentences.en: Lawrence told Vivian that Tiffany was looking forward to the Motown picnic on the weekend and he didn't have time to bring her home beforehand.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯告诉薇薇安，蒂芙尼很期待周末的摩城野餐会，他没时间提前把她送回家。

sentences.en: As had become the custom,
sentences.zh: 正如已经成为习惯的那样，

sentences.en: Lawrence put his job and celebrity lifestyle above his family, even as his firstborn son's life hung in the balance.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯把他的工作和名人生活置于家庭之上，即使他长子的生命正悬于一线。

sentences.en: As it turned out, both Lawrence and Tiffany would get to meet Trevor.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，劳伦斯和蒂芙尼最终都见到了特雷弗。

sentences.en: Despite suffering a multitude of health problems,
sentences.zh: 尽管遭受了多种健康问题，

sentences.en: Trevor was a fighter and survived.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗是个斗士，他活了下来。

sentences.en: Eventually, he was allowed home but required constant care and frequent hospitalisation.
sentences.zh: 最终，他被允许回家，但需要持续的护理和频繁的住院治疗。
